meta.name: ugc-repurposer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "repurpose influencer content", "turn one video into multiple ads", or "build a UGC asset library"; produces a content inventory with rights, a multi-channel repurposing map (1 video to 10+ assets), per-format transformation specs, and a 30-day distribution plan. Not for paid amplification spend planning — use content-amplifier.

copy.tagline: 把一条网红视频拆成十多种广告素材并规划分发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将网红内容高效复用为多渠道广告素材。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one influencer video into 10+ ad assets with a distribution plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to repurpose influencer content into multi-channel ad assets efficiently.

howto.what: 当用户要求将网红或用户生成内容（视频、评论、图片等）改编为多种格式时，Claude 会生成内容清单、多平台改编方案、格式转换规格和30天分发计划。
howto.when: 当用户提到“改编网红内容”、“把一个视频变成多个广告”或“建立UGC素材库”等关键词，或要求最大化现有UGC的ROI时触发。

say.text: 我们有三条很棒的TikTok视频，帮我做一个改编计划。
say.note: Claude 会输出内容清单、改编机会图和30天分发日历。

say.text: 把这条产品测评视频改编成广告、网站嵌入和社媒帖子。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体格式转换规格和渠道建议。

howto.what_en: When asked to repurpose influencer or user-generated content (videos, reviews, images) into multiple formats, Claude produces a content inventory with rights, a multi-channel repurposing map, per-format transformation specs, and a 30-day distribution plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'repurpose influencer content', 'turn one video into multiple ads', or 'build a UGC asset library', or asks to maximize ROI on existing UGC.

say_en.text: We have 3 great TikTok videos. Build a repurposing plan.
say_en.note: Claude outputs inventory, opportunity map, and 30-day calendar.

say_en.text: Adapt this product review into ads, website embed, and social posts.
say_en.note: Claude provides format specs and channel recommendations.
